958: Amalfi elects its first duke. Mastalus II was assassinated and Sergius I was elected first duke (Duchy page; the infobox instead lists Mastalus II, 957-958, as first duke); the Amalfi page: 'first elected a duke in 958'. Before him a prefect (839) and a judge (914, Mastalus I). The state and its land continue.

sources.title: Amalfi
sources.note: Cross-check: 839 and Byzantine vassalage, 'independent ... until 1073', the Salernitan dependency under Guaimar IV, 1131 under Roger II, the infobox area of the comune (5.7 km2).

notes: THE PAGES DISAGREE: the Duchy page has Amalfi free of Lombard rule in 839 and under Capua from 1034, Salerno from 1039, the Normans from 1073; the Amalfi page has an 'independent republic from the 7th century until 1073' that 'extracted itself from Byzantine vassalage in 839' and 'remained independent, except for a brief period of Salernitan dependency under Guaimar IV'. The ledger follows the Duchy page's dated list and records the 1034-1073 subjection as foreign control (occupation, hatched) at confidence 2; the end of the Salernitan control is page-silent and bridged at 1073 (confidence 1). Cliopatria draws Amalfi 960-1033 only (96 km2), so 839-959, 1096-1100 and 1130-1131 are new keyframes on its outline. START/END: the dossier runs 839-1131 (the Duchy page's free year to Roger II's reduction); the Amalfi page says the 'republic' lasted to 1073 or 'around 1200'; a gap-filler may prefer 1073. COUNTERPARTS NEEDING MATCHING EVENTS: principality-of-capua (gain 1034, loss 1039), principality-of-salerno (gain 1039; and the 981-983 rule of Salerno from Amalfi), norman-italy (gain 1073, loss 1096, gain 1101, loss 1130, gain 1131); Cliopatria's Principality of Capua and Salerno shapes do not include the Amalfi coast after 1033. The 1131 gain may belong to kingdom-of-sicily rather than norman-italy: the Duchy infobox names the Kingdom of Sicily as successor and the Amalfi page names Roger II 'of Sicily', while Cliopatria's Kingdom of Sicily row starts 1139 and its Norman Italy row runs to 1138. 981-983: the page says Amalfi ruled the Principality of Salerno without saying under whom; the Salerno agents should reconcile. AREA: Cliopatria 96 km2 against the Amalfi comune's 5.7 km2 (infobox of the Amalfi page); the pages give no area for the duchy. RULERS: only Mastalus II (957-958), Sergius I (958), Mastalus I (914), Manso (966-1004, Amalfi page) and Marinus Sebastus (1096-c.1100) appear; no ruler strip is written. COORDINATES of the capital are the town's. 1133-1137: Lothair took Roger prisoner, and Pisan ships sacked the city (Amalfi page, 1133, dubious) and the sacks of 1135 and 1137 lie after the dossier's end. Budget: two pages. No gazetteer name is needed.
